issue_context.title: System.ComponentModel.ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetConverter have incorrect nullable annotation
issue_context.body:
Interface `System.ComponentModel.ICustomTypeDescriptor` have nullable annotations, but method `GetConverter` is wrongly annotated to return non-null value, while [documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.componentmodel.icustomtypedescriptor.getconverter) says it could return `null`:

```
Returns
A TypeConverter that is the converter for this object, or null if there is no TypeConverter for this object
```

I propose to mark return value as nullable. It will be breaking change, but people would get `NullReferenceException` anyway if they wont check for `null`

@krwq - can you remember a reason why this was annotated this way in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/54961?

Looking through the code, I see some conflicting things:

1. The following places look like they don't accept `null`:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/6ca8c9bc0c4a5fc1082c690b6768ab3be8761b11/src/libraries/System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter/src/System/ComponentModel/TypeDescriptor.cs#L3239-L3240

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/6ca8c9bc0c4a5fc1082c690b6768ab3be8761b11/src/libraries/System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter/src/System/ComponentModel/TypeDescriptor.cs#L3549-L3551

2. These places seem to think returning `null` is acceptable:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/6ca8c9bc0c4a5fc1082c690b6768ab3be8761b11/src/libraries/System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter/src/System/ComponentModel/TypeDescriptor.cs#L2901-L2904

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/6ca8c9bc0c4a5fc1082c690b6768ab3be8761b11/src/libraries/System.Data.Common/src/System/Data/Common/DbDataRecord.cs#L80

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/6ca8c9bc0c4a5fc1082c690b6768ab3be8761b11/src/libraries/System.Data.Common/src/System/Data/Common/DataRecordInternal.cs#L321-L324

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/6ca8c9bc0c4a5fc1082c690b6768ab3be8761b11/src/libraries/System.Data.Common/src/System/Data/DataRowView.cs#L237

Since this is an interface that is implemented by external code, we should annotate it to be in-line with the documentation. The documentation indicates that `null` can be returned, so the API should be updated accordingly.

This seems incorrect - I suspect all internal implementations have returned non-null and I was looking only at the XML docs which was missing `null` remark (xml docs says only `Gets a type converter for this object.`) and with all large API surface I missed it.

I think unless implementation completely disagrees we should change it to match the docs.

review_comments: The code in this new GetDefaultTypeDescriptor is what you would have gotten from the GetTypeDescriptor override that was there before?

Correct. 

`NodeFor(type)` always returns a private class `TypeDescriptionNode`.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/62eb291312749c52507309d50051dd61538cc62d/src/libraries/System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter/src/System/ComponentModel/TypeDescriptor.cs#L1425

`GetTypeDescriptor(type)` is a non-virtual method on the base `TypeDescriptionProvider` class that forwards to the `GetTypeDescriptor(type, instance)` virtual method:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/62eb291312749c52507309d50051dd61538cc62d/src/libraries/System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter/src/System/ComponentModel/TypeDescriptionProvider.cs#L217-L220

Which is overriden by `TypeDescriptionNode` to always return a `DefaultTypeDescriptor`:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/62eb291312749c52507309d50051dd61538cc62d/src/libraries/System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter/src/System/ComponentModel/TypeDescriptor.cs#L3107-L3117

I wanted to do this for the `GetConverter` method that takes an object instance as well, but couldn't because there it can return either a `DefaultTypeDescriptor` or a `MergedTypeDescriptor`, so I had to continue letting the helper method return `ICustomTypeDescriptor` and added the assert that whomever we called returned non-null from `GetConverter()`.
